FRAME FORMAT: final512x512 cells in4columns2rows2048x1024, same proportional model size, common planted boot baseline and full transparent safe margins. Whole character and held hammer drawn coherently together in each cell. Edit reference1's approved blue CHRONOS animation to make a STRAIGHT-AHEAD CENTERLINE ground smash. Reference2 is the same canonical rigid metal T hammer. Preserve the existing chunky charcoal/silver armor, blue inserts, finned closed black helmet/narrowcyanvisor and round cyan chest core. Keep the same crisp detailed 16-bit sprite treatment and body proportions. Face, chest core, pelvis and the MIDPOINT BETWEEN BOTH BOOTS stay on each cell's vertical centerline. This new move must land DIRECTLY IN FRONT OF HIS BODY, not outside either boot.
Physical rules: the head is a hard metal cylinder with parallel black/silver endcaps and blue lightning barrel. One unbending metal shaft enters its SIDE MIDPOINT at a fixed90degree 3D joint. Both fists grip the SAME shaft together on the SAME side of the head. No offset elbow socket, no shaft bending or parallel shaft running down beside the cylinder, no grip on cylinder/helmet, no shaft through an endcap. Perspective may foreshorten the shaft naturally; the entire rigid head/haft rotates together. At impact the UPRIGHT cylindrical head is EXACTLY CENTERED between the two boots and forward of their toes, with its flat LOWER endcap down. To keep a visible STRAIGHT T joint, BOTH hands may finish slightly to viewer's RIGHT of the breast core at waist level: the one straight shaft recedes diagonally BACK/UP-RIGHT from the head's SIDE MIDPOINT into those close fists. The head stays centered, the BODY stays centered. No sideways hammer placement. Do not relocate the body to make a left blow look centered. The head never changes shape or squash at contact.
Complete feet, fins, pommel and hammer head in EVERY cell with safe margins; only character and hammer, genuine alpha background, no shadows/scenery/trails/FX/text/labels.
Reference1: approved old LEFT downswing as art/pose/style reference; move the whole HAMMER ARC into the centerline and redraw arms/hands as needed to retain rigid anatomy. Eight sequential poses:
0 maximal overhead windup, hands high above forehead on straight shaft, near ROUND cyan cap points toward camera in depth and barrel recedes back as in ref1 first pose.
1 begin pull straight forward in depth, hammer head remains centered over helmet.
2 accelerate down in front of face, head faces camera in depth, chest still visible as arms descend.
3 head passes in front of sternum, torso hinges forward, two fists shift slightly to right waist to keep straight side-jointed handle visible. Hammer's centerline remains over the middle of his stance.
4 late centered downstroke, head at CENTER between knees, cylinder pitches rigidly toward vertical; no mallet bending.
5 almost impact, cylinder upright at exact centerline before toes, hands together at right waist, long shaft straight to side joint.
6 solid impact: LOWER FLAT ENDCAP down on ground exactly on vertical line through chest/core and midpoint between boots. Both boots remain symmetric either side. Same rigid head dimensions, straight shaft back to fists.
7 body follow-through compression, hammer head stays on SAME CENTER ground contact without deformation.
